Smaller branches radiate at the upper left and a looped vessel segment curls at the bottom. Two lines of small colored on-screen text at the lower left ("Quick Measurement", green and brown/orange) have blurred, unreadable values, and a small white standing-human orientation icon is at the lower right. A white letter A is at the upper left.

Branches radiate at upper right; a small white standing-human orientation icon is at the lower right; a white letter C is at the upper left. No readable text or scale.
